Established by Simon Hope in 1999, Hillcrest are an Independent Porsche Specialist serving the local area and beyond. Simon served his apprenticeship with Porsche Cars Great Britain and also worked for Official Porsche dealers including Maltins of Henley. ALL OUR WORKMANSHIP IS OF THE HIGHEST STANDARD AND FULLY GUARANTEED. The workshop provides a fully qualified team of mechanics with excellent background experience with not only Porsche but Bentley, Aston Martin, Lamborghini, Land Rover, Ferrari, BMW, all types of vintage cars, sports cars and other vehicles. We specialise in servicing Porsche cars of all ages, both air and water cooled, using up-to-date equipment.
